system.title: System event logs
system.description: The audit subsystem's own state and checks.
system.scope: This page shows only the audit subsystem's own system events: what has been captured and not yet stored, what keeps failing, and how far the Activity timeline trails the audit store, with its integrity and consistency checks. It is not the formal audit trail, and it is not an observability or SIEM console: application logs, metrics and security analytics are kept in the operations and SIEM tooling.
system.projectionLag: Events not yet in the Activity timeline
system.checksNote: Each check reads the store without changing it, and is itself recorded as audit evidence.
system.projectionTitle: Activity timeline against the audit store

activity.title: Activity history
